authorship: Codex, responding to user instruction to execute P00 and C00
owner_role: DomainSpec product owner; product decisions remain owner-controlled
scope_basis: User selected P00/C00 from the five-track DAG; this records scope, not product approval.

tracks.title: Stable 1.0 compiler
tracks.included_outcome: Exact existing @10 backend catalogue: 13 types × TypeScript/Python/Rust = 39 realization rows; documented root API, command/schema/exit contracts; bounded Lean checks; existing single AWS recipe target remains candidate.
tracks.evidence_denominator: All 28 explicitly scheduled CLI test files, frozen model checks, system-integration checks, Rust generation and isolated package consumers; two-run L1 qualification; immutable bundle and independent review.
tracks.claim_ceiling: No production-runtime or all-provider claim. Experimental run/subpath remain outside 1.x compatibility.
tracks.completion_condition: All selected denominator entries have current evidence, independent review and exact candidate-bound product approval; missing entries fail closed.

tracks.title: One compiler-to-EVF integration
tracks.included_outcome: One finite compiler graph/obligation profile and one independently authored consumer, selected at E01.
tracks.evidence_denominator: Every enumerated owned obligation needs positive and cause-specific negative evidence, current digest binding and independent consumer verification.
tracks.claim_ceiling: Existing EVF reference evidence must be reconciled; no universal theorem or general provider adoption.
tracks.completion_condition: All selected denominator entries have current evidence, independent review and exact candidate-bound product approval; missing entries fail closed.

tracks.title: One durable recovery profile
tracks.included_outcome: One local provider and one language selected at R01; coordination-store, replay-ledger, fencing, retry and restart contracts.
tracks.evidence_denominator: Every selected crash boundary, stale lease, duplicate invocation, conflicting version, retry terminal and restart case in a finite failure matrix.
tracks.claim_ceiling: No universal exactly-once effects, all-provider equivalence or live operational guarantee.
tracks.completion_condition: All selected denominator entries have current evidence, independent review and exact candidate-bound product approval; missing entries fail closed.

tracks.title: One UI profile
tracks.included_outcome: One framework and one end-to-end user journey selected at U01; dispositions for Page, Layout, Component, ViewModel, Hook, Form, Action, Guard, Binding, Adapter and State Indicator.
tracks.evidence_denominator: Every included type/relationship and selected interaction, adverse-state, accessibility and generated/source parity obligation.
tracks.claim_ceiling: Excluded types and frameworks are explicit; no general UI generator completion claim.
tracks.completion_condition: All selected denominator entries have current evidence, independent review and exact candidate-bound product approval; missing entries fail closed.

tracks.title: Selected legacy migration
tracks.included_outcome: Finite current consumer/import-row inventory fixed at L00/L01; retain, adapt or explicitly exclude each row.
tracks.evidence_denominator: Each retained/adapted row has consumer and semantic-parity evidence; each excluded row has a reason and no completed-implementation claim.
tracks.claim_ceiling: Retirement planning grants no deletion; universal legacy compatibility excluded.
tracks.completion_condition: All selected denominator entries have current evidence, independent review and exact candidate-bound product approval; missing entries fail closed.

join.denominator: Exact selected profile manifests and shared-contract/version/digest matrix across the five products, with integrated regression, independent review and final owner product decision.

operational_support.basis: Isolated full committed checkout and exact toolchain are required for reproducible checks.
Separate read-only evidence retrieval, operational envelopes and effects; not P00/C00 prerequisites.
Stale status reconciliation cannot gate construction.
Offline preparation followed by separately authorized live work.

exclusions: Rewriting frozen EVF candidates or historical decisions
acceptance_rules: Each milestone closes only when every ancestor and its terminal have current owner-bound evidence.
Structural DAG validation is not product validation or approval.
No required failure is hidden as skipped; dependent checks are not_evaluable.
No optional/deferred item may be silently counted as completed.
Existing evidence may discharge a node only after exact source and scope reconciliation.
Product approval is separate from operational authorization and effects.
change_policy: Changing selected source, finite profile, denominator or shared contract creates a successor evidence epoch and reopens affected downstream checks; never reduce the denominator to disguise failures.

ontology_dependencies.note: P00 uses the DAG and project prose only. C00 records compiler-bound baseline/profile input identities; it does not reevaluate or admit their ontology.
